messages:
nora: Heads-up — runtime v4.1 rolled into canary ~15m ago. Early signal: routes that use `model_pin` are returning `bind_version_mismatch` on quantized llama variants when SDK 3.x appends `model_tag`. Not huge but reproducible.

sam: I can repro locally by hitting a pinned route and toggling the model variant header. Error shows up in binding layer: `bind_version_mismatch: expected variant, got variant_tag`.

lee: This smells like field-name drift between SDK and runtime. Options: (A) targeted runtime pin for pinned-route cohorts, (B) SDK pin back to 3.1 for affected routes, (C) quick adapter to accept both names. My preference: targeted runtime pin + adapter in parallel. Lowest customer blast radius.

nora: Agree. We'll soft-pin runtime to 4.0 for `pinned-model-*` cohorts in prod and canary, land an adapter in the runtime to accept both `variant` and `model_tag`, then remove the pin once adapter validated. Also add explicit rollback thresholds.

deploybot: canary digest: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/2940012345 — overall green except `pinned-route` cohort showing 2.4% `bind_version_mismatch`.

sam: I'll open the adapter PR (small change — runtime accepts `model_tag` as alias for legacy `variant`) and add unit + integration tests. PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/9942

lee: Proposed pin config (short-lived):
```
pinlist:
  - runtime: "4.0.12"
    routes:
      - "pinned-model-*"
    reason: "runtime 4.1 variant field rename -> bind_version_mismatch for pinned routes"
    owner: "eng-runtime"
    applied_by: "nora"
```

ops-oncall: I'll block automatic unpin for the Nightly change window (23:00-03:00 UTC) and stand watch during ramp. If `bind_version_mismatch` >5% sustained for 10m OR customer 5xxs increase >1% absolute => remove pin and trigger rollback runbook.

deploybot: Applied pin at 2940013200 to cohort `pinned-model-prod` by @nora. Pin details visible in dashboard.

nora: Adding release-notes advisory: "If you pin model versions and rely on model variant metadata, runtime v4.1 may change the variant field name; we've applied a temporary pin for pinned routes. We recommend leaving pin unset while we validate the adapter, or pin to runtime 4.0 if you see `bind_version_mismatch`. Contact support for help migrating."

sam: Adapter PR ready for canary; running 10k-request integration harness now. If mismatch drops below 0.2% over 30m we'll plan a gradual unpin: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m holds.

lee: Also adding a short note for SDK team to avoid shipping further field-name-only changes without a deprecation window; we'll add a compatibility section to the release notes pipeline.

ops-oncall: Monitoring active. I'll post alerts in #incidents if thresholds trip. :eyes:

nora: TL;DR: soft-pin applied to pinned-route cohorts, adapter PR in canary, rollback thresholds set, prod unpin blocked until canary validates. I'll draft the ops blurb and the customer comms. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
